description: NaY₉Si₆O₂₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.93 Å. There are five inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.80 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.67 Å. In the third Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.76 Å. In the fourth Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.78 Å. In the fifth Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.66 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Y atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Y atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Y and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Y, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Y and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Y and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Y and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Y, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Y and one Si atom to form distorted edge-sharing OY₃Si tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Y, and one Si atom.
